title: French 政府 Calls Emergency 会议 与 平台 超过 Protests
content: TikTok 和 other sites 是 告诉 到 curb protest footage 和 AI-altered 图像,当 在线 retailers 像 Vinted 和 eBay reportedly signed 协议 停止 looted goods 从 flooding resale sites.
original_title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
original_content: TikTok and other sites were told to curb protest footage and AI-altered images, while online retailers like Vinted and eBay reportedly signed an agreement stop looted goods from flooding resale sites.

title: OpenAI 收购 初创公司 Orchestra Bio⁠ 到 beef 上 它的 biotech 业务
content: OpenAI 表示 它's adding Orchestra's 团队 和 技术 到 工作 在 Rosalind,它的 AI 模型 为 life sciences 研究,和 到 它的 related Rosalind Workbench 工具,harness 那个 目标 到 帮助 研究人员 计划 experiments 和 分析 结果.
original_title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
original_content: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
